description: Given agent-supplied facts, decide whether a standup is due. Triggers in priority order: a deliverable gate reached → 'gate'; else a dependency intersection → 'intersection'; else more than five working days since the last standup → 'weekly'; else 'none'. Working days are an input (the working week varies by team), never computed from a calendar. Returns { due, reason, detail }.
name: standup_due
title: Judge whether a standup is due
